scope: Source audit, not a claim of exhaustive feature or execution coverage.

features.title: Reflection and bidirectional calls
features.gap: Inherited from UnLua; no current execution evidence.
features.acceptance: Test null, exception, out/ref, defaults and backend equivalence.

features.title: Blueprint overrides, inheritance and RPC overrides
features.gap: Ordinary overrides exist; inheritance/net/reinstance combinations incomplete.
features.acceptance: Run parent/child/super, interface, RPC and Blueprint recompile scenarios.

features.title: Containers, structs and borrowed views
features.gap: Borrowed child/iterator invalidation and property metadata need lifetime audit.
features.acceptance: Destroy parent, mutate/reallocate containers, reinstance Blueprint and force GC.

features.title: Singlecast, multicast and callback ownership
features.gap: No complete token/dedup/owner teardown acceptance; preserve singlecast semantics.
features.acceptance: Test duplicate binding, reentrant removal, owner destruction, hot reload, multiple Env.

features.title: Input, animation and UI workflows
features.gap: Examples exist; full EnhancedInput/animation/UMG lifecycle acceptance missing.
features.acceptance: Run real RHI scenarios, input rebinding, UI release and animation callbacks on both backends.

features.title: Plain C++ template/static exports
features.gap: Not arbitrary C++ parsing; destructor and ABI behavior require current execution.
features.acceptance: Test constructors/destructors, overloads, inheritance, globals and non-reflected methods.

features.title: Generated marshalling thunks
features.gap: Still calls ProcessEvent; unsupported/static/net/complex signatures fall back.
features.acceptance: Prove generated/fallback equivalence and add a reproducible generation example.

features.title: Independent modules on same-class instances
features.gap: UClass-keyed cache short-circuits binding; not FUnLua-style per-instance binding.
features.acceptance: Bind A/B modules to same class, verify isolation through inheritance/reload/unbind.

features.title: Owned, borrowed and manual userdata finalization
features.gap: AddManualRef proxy relies on __gc on Luau; full allocation audit incomplete.
features.acceptance: Force both collectors; prove release counts and safety under both teardown orders.

features.title: Multiple VM/World environments
features.gap: Core multi-env exists; Timer and cache/diagnostic attribution need isolation checks.
features.acceptance: Create/destroy/recreate Env and World, reuse addresses, forbid cross-environment handles.

features.title: Coroutines and latent calls
features.gap: C boundary yield and abandoned coroutine teardown need coverage.
features.acceptance: Test yield/resume/errors/cancellation with Env and World teardown.

features.title: World timers
features.gap: Raw coroutine state, no Env close cleanup, first-world lookup; existing tests mostly API shape.
features.acceptance: Test due/pause/unscaled/reentry plus coroutine GC, Env-first/World-first destruction and multi-PIE.

features.title: Event bus and Once reentrancy
features.gap: Tokens retain owner until explicit unsubscribe; not automatic UObject lifecycle cleanup.
features.acceptance: Run recursive Once and cleanup tests; add exception/reload/owner destruction scenarios.

features.title: Pure Lua classes
features.gap: Lua class helper is distinct from UE UClass and experimental Luau classes.
features.acceptance: Validate constructor chain, Super, class/instance identity and both backend examples.

features.title: Hot reload and closure identity
features.gap: Luau upvalue identity is approximate; shared scalar aliases and rollback not proven.
features.acceptance: Test shared closures, table cycles, delegates, active coroutine and failed reload rollback.

features.title: Declared server/client/multicast RPC
features.gap: Sorting added; inheritance, class/net caches, security and cooked acceptance incomplete.
features.acceptance: Connected DS + 2 clients, ownership rejection, reliable/unreliable, reconnect and schema mismatch.

features.title: Property conditions and schemas
features.gap: Instance-derived class-cached conditions; type bucket conflicts; unknown conditions fall back.
features.acceptance: Fix layout design; test mixed conditions/types across actors, owner/nonowner, late join and dormancy.

features.title: Replication types, int64 and Iris/push model
features.gap: Fixed primitive/math/object types; no arbitrary struct/container support; Luau int64 truncation.
features.acceptance: Exact integer boundaries, object resolution, legacy/Iris/push combinations and packaged peers.

features.title: Language/compiler surface
features.gap: Pinned compiler supports syntax; not a full integrated conformance run.
features.acceptance: Import pinned syntax/interpolation/if-expression/generics/iteration conformance with documented exclusions.

features.title: base, math, string, table, utf8, bit32, coroutine
features.gap: VM libraries exposed; tests sample behavior rather than all upstream conformance.
features.acceptance: Run library/metatable/error/weak-table conformance and host-specific exclusions.

features.title: Native vector and FVector interoperability
features.gap: float vector versus UE double FVector loses precision.
features.acceptance: Test conversion/parameter/operator edges and document precision budget.

features.title: Native buffer and UE array copies
features.gap: Copies rather than external-memory aliases; output array type differs from uint8.
features.acceptance: Bounds/type/value tests and verify source/buffer independence; measure copy cost.

features.title: Native compilation
features.gap: VM-scoped initialization fixed; request counter is not success count; platform acceptance absent.
features.acceptance: Test VM/coroutine lifecycle, supported architectures, debug attachment, failures and executable-memory policy.

features.title: Incremental GC and budgets
features.gap: Not generational or multithreaded GC; budgets are not proven hard pause limits.
features.acceptance: Measure pauses and allocation pressure; validate tuning, errors and destruction callbacks.

features.title: Readonly globals, threads and class tables
features.gap: Default off; host UE/debug/io/socket capabilities remain; not an untrusted-code permission model.
features.acceptance: Define capability policy and verify writable escape paths, new threads, imports and host limits.

features.title: Type inference, declarations and LSP
features.gap: External checker; declarations approximate containers/delegates and skips may occur.
features.acceptance: Require checker and fresh declarations; verify inference/generics/overloads/type-functions and negative fixtures.

features.title: Host module loader versus upstream Require
features.gap: Host searchers/preload differ from upstream Require relative paths/aliases/config.
features.acceptance: Document resolution/cycle/cache contract and add alias/case/cook tests or explicit unsupported errors.

features.title: Coverage export and quality gates
features.gap: Compiler option exists; complete result export, source mapping and gate are absent.
features.acceptance: Produce per-source counts with exclusions, aggregate backend runs, fail on missing data.

features.title: Experimental integer and user-defined class libraries
features.gap: Upstream flag-controlled APIs are not stable integration promises.
features.acceptance: Record flags, compatibility/ABI/type declarations and tests before exposing as stable.

features.title: debug, upvalues and uservalues
features.gap: Registry/uservalue placeholders and approximate upvalue identity.
features.acceptance: Reject unsupported operations or implement exact subset; test closure identity and error cases.

features.title: Optional rooted buffered io
features.gap: CRLF/path/read checks improved; modes/seek/errors/links/quotas remain incomplete; not Lua io parity.
features.acceptance: Compare subset against Lua, including binary/large files, mutated handles, failure and root changes.

features.title: Lua 5.x integer, close, goto and bytecode differences
features.gap: No language-level equivalence; source-only load mode and bytecode/version policy incomplete.
features.acceptance: Publish migration contracts and explicit failures; verify int64, close alternatives and trusted bytecode.

features.title: Debug service and DAP
features.gap: Attach/evaluate/pause exist; packaged remote support, authorization and reconnect unverified.
features.acceptance: Break/step/locals/upvalues across multiple Env and coroutine; malformed frames and disconnect cleanup.

features.title: CPU, self time, memory and flamegraphs
features.gap: Sampled/measured attribution differs; tool wrapper requires initialized pinned VM tools.
features.acceptance: Validate stack/yield/GC attribution, overhead and malformed dumps; produce an end-to-end example.

features.title: Dead-loop and coroutine diagnostics
features.gap: Detection exists; quotas and cancellation are not complete hostile-code controls.
features.acceptance: Test timeout/reset/teardown, native callbacks and abandoned coroutine attribution.

features.title: Socket, protobuf and JSON
features.gap: Backend lifetime/ABI/error and distribution notices need component-level verification.
features.acceptance: Large/malformed payloads, socket close/failure, userdata GC and packaged linkage on both backends.

features.title: Test framework, reports and build identity
features.gap: Static classification is not coverage; reports lack complete reproducible build identity.
features.acceptance: Fail missing/empty/malformed runs; record commit/dirty/dependencies/flags/topology; require type tools.

features.title: Comparable benchmarks and regression gates
features.gap: Threshold code exists; committed perf baselines and controlled external results absent.
features.acceptance: Same hardware/UE/config, raw multi-run distributions, memory/startup/GC/code-size metrics.

features.title: Cooked targets, platforms and upgrades
features.gap: No current platform/Shipping evidence; editor-only type/debug tools differ from runtime.
features.acceptance: Cooked scripts/assets/extensions, DS/client, feature-off, executable-memory targets and upgrade tests.

features.title: License scope and provenance
features.gap: Root/file scope unresolved; extension notices incomplete; FUnLua license file missing.
features.acceptance: Rights-holder scope decision, file/component provenance, complete notices in distributable artifact.
